wholePhysicalScope: Named OSM relation 9149272 fixes the site limits. The paired mapped sets of wall lines preserve the visible rampart pattern. Individual OSM ways separately locate the east portal, central Bala Qila, and the mosque.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the paired rampart lines, the mapped citadel, main gate, and distinctive Jama Masjid roof and arcade mass.
limitations: Wall crests, details of damaged western outworks, dome heights and material hues are estimates from the mapped fabric and historical views.
The model depicts the surviving exterior and the roofed mosque arcades. It omits later uses of the precinct, the unverified western outwork, and interiors beyond the arcades.
